DE02:cross-record-atomicity.why: One batch commits or nothing: a refused, ack-lost or assembly-failed commit leaves no table/document write and no adopted revision.

DE02:before-after-ack-failure.why: A commit failing before or after the backend applied it is fatal and never adopted; a StorageRequestError from commit is never exempt.

DE02:immutable-ids.why: Minted IDs come from Storage and are never reused after a rolled-back callback.

DE02:no-alias-ingress.why: Table rows and draft placements own detached copies; a caller mutation after the op settles reaches nothing stored, published or returned, while a nested one made while the append is pending is captured on both sides (top-level keys are not exercised).

DE02b:read-after-write.why: Table reads only before the first table write (also a sync set_task); document access stays allowed.

DE02b:final-owner-checks.why: New owned work is validated against the owner's final candidate at assembly.

DE02b:no-late-initializer.why: An acquisition finishing after settlement never initializes, mints or stages.

DE02b:no-draft-escape.why: Escaped, nested and returned drafts and a captured Tx are revoked at settlement; affinity is Python-only and native.

DE02b:queued-cancel-cut.why: A cancelled queued commit never enters its callback and FIFO order holds; Task.cancel rows are Python-only.

DE02b:running-callback-and-admitted-comm.why: Cancellation after the grant neither cuts a running callback nor an admitted commit; a cancelled caller's failed read is exempt.

DE02b:first-failure-poisoning.why: The first failure wins and poisons every later Tx call, the post-callback health check and every queued commit (rejection timing is Python-only).

DE02b:late-read-discard.why: A read underway when another call fails the Session ends with SessionFailed and nothing it read is used.

DE02b:commit-before-adopt-publication.why: Storage returns, the revision is adopted (snapshots share the published value), then listeners run before the caller resumes.

DE02b:publication-after-storage-only.why: Only an acknowledged, adopted commit publishes; empty and failed batches publish nothing.

DE02b:adopt-failure.why: Native-only: the bounded Pi subclass has no route into the #host-built Transaction.adopt.

DE02b:listeners.why: Internal listener errors fail the Session while the commit resolves; host and close listeners are contained and reported; coroutine listeners are Python-only.

DE02b:reentry.why: Native-only: Pi hangs on a line reentry (types.ts Session contract); Python refuses it with ReentrantSessionCall.

DE02b:close-drain-barriers.why: Close seals admission at once, settles admitted and queued work, admits guard reads until the line drains, then closes Storage once.

DE02b2:no-op-suppression.why: A value no-op writes and publishes nothing; the op-based structural no-op (session-documents 190) stays DE04/DE27.

DE02b:committed-snapshots.why: Snapshots return the committed revision only: the old one while a commit is held, the cold-loaded one, never a candidate.

DE02b:pending-operations.why: Pending Tx operations are drained before the line moves on; a callback error wins over the pending check.

DE02:kernel-storage-spec.why: Documentation atom: the harness spec's durable Session section and the durable-reference comparison section cross-link a1/a2/b.
